chief_complaint: Follow-up for cardiometabolic risk management and post‑myocardial infarction care, including hypertension, type 2 diabetes, and chronic pain.
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 57‑year‑old male with a longstanding history of hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, obesity, metabolic syndrome, and hypertriglyceridemia. He suffered an acute ST‑segment elevation myocardial infarction in 2013 and has been on secondary‑prevention therapy since. Diabetes is complicated by peripheral neuropathy diagnosed in 2019. Blood pressure today shows isolated diastolic hypertension (124/97 mmHg). Recent A1c is 5.6 % (date not recorded). He reports chronic low‑back and neck pain managed with intermittent ibuprofen. Socially, he experiences housing instability, limited social contact, exposure to violence, and has a criminal record, all of which may affect adherence. Pulmonary medications for childhood asthma are still active despite no current asthma diagnosis documented. Laboratory data are incomplete (no recent lipid panel, eGFR, BMI). Overall, his clinical picture reflects high cardiovascular and metabolic risk with multiple psychosocial stressors.

active_problems.name: Acute ST segment elevation myocardial infarction
Neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus
